mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT PB.ORDER_NO , PB.ORDER_CODE FROM ( SELECT PA.ORDER_NO , PA.ORDER_CODE FROM ( SELECT /*+ USE_NL(A B) INDEX(A T_HAPPYCON_COUPON_IDX6) */ B.ORDER_NO , B.ORDER_CODE , (CASE WHEN B.ORDER_STATE IN ('19','91','72') THEN 0 WHEN B.ORDER_STATE IN ('15','27','40') THEN (CASE WHEN A.CPN_STATE = 'N' OR (A.CPN_STATE ='E' AND A.CPN_TYPE = 'A' AND A.REM_AMT > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ELSE 1 END) AS AVL_CNT FROM HC_MALL.T_HAPPYCON_COUPON A , HC_MALL.T_ORDER B WHERE A.ORDER_NO = B.ORDER_NO AND A.UPD_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{day},'YYYYMMDD') AND A.UPD_DATE < TO_DATE(#{day},'YYYYMMDD') + 1 AND A.ORDER_NO LIKE 'OR%' AND LENGTH(B.RCV_PHONE) <= 30 ) PA WHERE PA.AVL_CNT = 0 UNION ALL SELECT PA.ORDER_NO , PA.ORDER_CODE FROM ( SELECT /*+ USE_NL(A B C) INDEX(B T_HAPPYCON_COUPON_MULTI_IDX1) */ A.ORDER_NO , A.ORDER_CODE , SUM(CASE WHEN A.ORDER_STATE IN ('19','91','72') THEN 0 WHEN A.ORDER_STATE IN ('15','27','40') THEN (CASE WHEN C.CPN_STATE = 'N' OR (C.CPN_STATE ='E' AND C.CPN_TYPE = 'A' AND C.REM_AMT > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ELSE 1 END) AS AVL_CNT FROM ( SELECT /*+ USE_NL(IA IB IC) INDEX(IA T_HAPPYCON_COUPON_IDX6) */ IC.ORDER_NO , IC.ORDER_CODE , IC.ORDER_STATE FROM HC_MALL.T_HAPPYCON_COUPON IA , HC_MALL.T_HAPPYCON_COUPON_MULTI IB , HC_MALL.T_ORDER IC WHERE IA.ORDER_NO = IB.CPN_ORDER_NO AND IB.ORDER_NO = IC.ORDER_NO AND IA.UPD_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{day},'YYYYMMDD') AND IA.UPD_DATE < TO_DATE(#{day},'YYYYMMDD') + 1 AND IA.ORDER_NO NOT LIKE 'OR%' AND LENGTH(IC.RCV_PHONE) <= 30 GROUP BY IC.ORDER_NO , IC.ORDER_CODE , IC.ORDER_STATE ) A , HC_MALL.T_HAPPYCON_COUPON_MULTI B , HC_MALL.T_HAPPYCON_COUPON C WHERE A.ORDER_NO = B.ORDER_NO AND B.CPN_ORDER_NO = C.ORDER_NO GROUP BY A.ORDER_NO , A.ORDER_CODE ) PA WHERE PA.AVL_CNT = 0 UNION ALL SELECT PA.ORDER_NO , PA.ORDER_CODE FROM ( SELECT /*+ USE_NL(A B C) INDEX(A T_HAPPYCON_COUPON_IDX6) */ C.ORDER_NO , C.ORDER_CODE , SUM(CASE WHEN C.ORDER_STATE IN ('19','91','72') THEN 0 WHEN C.ORDER_STATE IN ('15','27','40') THEN (CASE WHEN A.CPN_STATE IS NULL OR A.CPN_STATE = 'Issued' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ELSE 1 END) AS AVL_CNT FROM HC_MALL.T_OUTSIDE_COUPON A , HC_MALL.T_OUTSIDE_OCCUR B , HC_MALL.T_ORDER C WHERE A.OCCUR_CODE = B.OCCUR_CODE AND B.ORDER_NO = C.ORDER_NO AND A.UPD_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{day},'YYYYMMDD') AND A.UPD_DATE < TO_DATE(#{day},'YYYYMMDD') + 1 AND LENGTH(C.RCV_PHONE) <= 30 GROUP BY C.ORDER_NO , C.ORDER_CODE ) PA WHERE PA.AVL_CNT = 0 ) PB

SELECT DISTINCT PB.ORDER_NO , PB.ORDER_CODE FROM ( SELECT /*+ INDEX(A T_ORDER_IDX4) */ A.ORDER_NO , A.ORDER_CODE FROM HC_MALL.T_ORDER A WHERE A.ORDER_STATE = '00' AND A.ORDER_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{day},'YYYYMMDD') - 2 AND A.ORDER_DATE < TO_DATE(#{day},'YYYYMMDD') - 1 AND LENGTH(A.RCV_PHONE) <= 30 ) PB

MERGE INTO T_OUTSIDE_MMS PA USING ( SELECT /*+ USE_NL(A B C) */ C.* FROM HC_MALL.T_OUTSIDE_OCCUR A , HC_MALL.T_OUTSIDE_COUPON B , HC_MALL.T_OUTSIDE_MMS C WHERE A.OCCUR_CODE = B.OCCUR_CODE AND B.CPN_NO = C.CPN_NO AND A.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} ) PB ON (PA.MMS_CODE = PB.MMS_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PA.USER_PHONE = PB.USER_PHONE , PA.RCV_PHONE = PB.RCV_PHONE , PA.UPD_DATE = PB.UPD_DATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( PA.MMS_CODE , PA.CPN_NO , PA.USER_PHONE , PA.RCV_PHONE , PA.SEND_SUBJ , PA.SEND_CTT , PA.RPS_CD , PA.RPS_MSG , PA.REG_ID , PA.REG_DATE , PA.UPD_ID , PA.UPD_DATE ) VALUES ( PB.MMS_CODE , PB.CPN_NO , PB.USER_PHONE , PB.RCV_PHONE , PB.SEND_SUBJ , PB.SEND_CTT , PB.RPS_CD , PB.RPS_MSG , PB.REG_ID , PB.REG_DATE , PB.UPD_ID , SYSDATE )

UPDATE HC_MALL.T_OUTSIDE_MMS A SET A.USER_PHONE = (CASE WHEN LENGTH(A.USER_PHONE) <= 30 THEN (CASE WHEN TRIM(REPLACE(A.USER_PHONE,'-','')) IS NOT NULL THEN RAWTOHEX(STANDARD_HASH(REPLACE(A.USER_PHONE,'-',''),'SHA256')) ELSE ' ' END) ELSE A.USER_PHONE END) , A.RCV_PHONE = (CASE WHEN LENGTH(A.RCV_PHONE) <= 30 THEN (CASE WHEN TRIM(REPLACE(A.RCV_PHONE,'-','')) IS NOT NULL THEN RAWTOHEX(STANDARD_HASH(REPLACE(A.RCV_PHONE,'-',''),'SHA256')) ELSE ' ' END) ELSE A.RCV_PHONE END) WHERE A.MMS_CODE IN ( SELECT /*+ USE_NL(IA IB IC) */ IC.MMS_CODE FROM HC_MALL.T_OUTSIDE_OCCUR IA , HC_MALL.T_OUTSIDE_COUPON IB , HC_MALL.T_OUTSIDE_MMS IC WHERE IA.OCCUR_CODE = IB.OCCUR_CODE AND IB.CPN_NO = IC.CPN_NO AND IA.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} )

MERGE INTO T_REFUND_ACC_INFO PA USING ( SELECT A.* FROM HC_MALL.T_REFUND_ACC_INFO A WHERE A.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} ) PB ON (PA.SEQ = PB.SEQ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PA.ACC_NO = (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(REPLACE(PB.ACC_NO,'-','')),'[^0-9]') OR TRIM(PB.ACC_NO) IS NULL THEN PB.ACC_NO ELSE MIG_CRYPTO.ENCRYPT('YwhcdktWPDeztoJlNv0rjOQFU7bfcKp3','H7DRWbABL42663Lb',REPLACE(PB.ACC_NO,'-','')) END) , PA.ACC_NAME = PB.ACC_NAME , PA.ACC_PHONE = PB.ACC_PHONE WHERE TRIM(PB.ACC_NO) IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(PB.ACC_PHONE) <= 30 AND PB.ACC_NO NOT LIKE '***%' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( PA.SEQ , PA.ORDER_NO , PA.CPN_ORDER_NO , PA.BANK_CODE , PA.ACC_NO , PA.ACC_NAME , PA.ACC_PHONE , PA.REQ_TYPE , PA.REG_ID , PA.REG_DATE , PA.UPD_ID , PA.UPD_DATE ) VALUES ( PB.SEQ , PB.ORDER_NO , PB.CPN_ORDER_NO , PB.BANK_CODE , PB.ACC_NO , PB.ACC_NAME , PB.ACC_PHONE , PB.REQ_TYPE , PB.REG_ID , PB.REG_DATE , PB.UPD_ID , SYSDATE )

MERGE INTO HC_MALL.T_REFUND_ACC_INFO PA USING ( SELECT A.SEQ , (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(A.ACC_NO,'[^0-9]') THEN REPLACE(MIG_CRYPTO.DECRYPT('YwhcdktWPDeztoJlNv0rjOQFU7bfcKp3','H7DRWbABL42663Lb',A.ACC_NO),'-','') ELSE A.ACC_NO END) AS ACC_NO , SUBSTR(A.ACC_NAME,1,1) || LPAD('*', LENGTH(A.ACC_NAME) - 1,'*') AS ACC_NAME , (CASE WHEN TRIM(REPLACE(A.ACC_PHONE,'-','')) IS NOT NULL THEN RAWTOHEX(STANDARD_HASH(REPLACE(A.ACC_PHONE,'-',''),'SHA256')) ELSE ' ' END) AS ACC_PHONE FROM HC_MALL.T_REFUND_ACC_INFO A WHERE A.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND LENGTH(A.ACC_PHONE) <= 30 AND TRIM(A.ACC_NO) IS NOT NULL ) PB ON (PA.SEQ = PB.SEQ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PA.ACC_NO = LPAD('*',LENGTH(REPLACE(PB.ACC_NO,'-','')) - 4,'*') || SUBSTR(REPLACE(PA.ACC_NO,'-',''),LENGTH(REPLACE(PA.ACC_NO,'-','')) - 3) , PA.ACC_NAME = PB.ACC_NAME , PA.ACC_PHONE = PB.ACC_PHONE

MERGE INTO T_REFUND_IN_LOG PA USING ( SELECT /*+ USE_NL(A B) */ B.* FROM HC_MALL.T_REFUND_ACC_INFO A , HC_MALL.T_REFUND_IN_LOG B WHERE A.SEQ = B.ACC_SEQ AND A.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} ) PB ON (PA.SEQ = PB.SEQ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PA.RCV_PHONE = PB.RCV_PHONE , PA.UPD_DATE = PB.UPD_DATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( PA.SEQ , PA.ACC_SEQ , PA.RCV_PHONE , PA.REG_ID , PA.REG_DATE , PA.UPD_ID , PA.UPD_DATE ) VALUES ( PB.SEQ , PB.ACC_SEQ , PB.RCV_PHONE , PB.REG_ID , PB.REG_DATE , PB.UPD_ID , SYSDATE )
